A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the source characteristics are important factors to consider when designing an effective social engineering defense mechanism in SNSs.
the source characteristics of social engineering attacks in SNSs are not only the source characteristics of the social engineer but also the characteristics of the victim.
the more the attacker uses source characteristics, the more the users are deceived, and the less they are aware of the social engineering attack.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the source characteristics of the attacker (e.g., profile picture, profile information, and number of friends) are the main factors influencing users' susceptibility to the social engineering attacks on SNSs.
source characteristics, such as source's profile, source's behavior, and source's social network, are significant in predicting Facebook users' susceptibility to impersonation attacks.
